description: Post a message in a channel that only one member sees, until they reload Slack.

channel.description: Conversation id: channel_id from a slack.event.

user.description: Member id, such as user_id from a slack.event.

text.description: Message text in Markdown, converted to Slack formatting.

thread_ts.description: Thread to answer in: the event's thread_ts, or its message_ts to start a thread under that message.

team_id.description: Workspace: team_id from the slack.event. Needed only when this interface serves several workspaces.
